name: What kind of warranty is offered on a new custom home?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty is offered on a new custom home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most reputable custom home builders offer a warranty to cover defects in materials and workmanship. Typically, this includes a one-year warranty on the entire home, covering components like appliances and finishes. Longer warranties, often 2-5 years, might cover major systems like plumbing, electrical, and HVAC. Structural components, such as the foundation and framing, often carry a 10-year warranty. We provide a comprehensive warranty package detailing what is covered and for how long, ensuring peace of mind for our clients.
acceptedAnswer.description: New custom homes typically come with a 1-year warranty on the home, 2-5 years on systems, and 10 years on structural components.
